messages:
elaine_sales: Heads-up — AcmeCorp wants BYOK cutover during the POC (week of 5/12). They pushed back on our default rotation window and asked about pen-test scheduling + ops queue latency. Can we triage blockers?

omar_solutions: Thanks. Quick clarifying q's: do they require HSM-backed CMKs (FIPS, attestation), or will a cloud-KMS + TLS-proxy suffice for POC? Also need expected QPS / concurrency to size HSM throughput.

maria_security: From the security questionnaire they returned: "Key material MUST reside in customer-controlled HSM or equivalent; monthly rotation preferred; split custody for key escrow; audit logs retained 1y; attestation report on demand."

maria_security: TL;DR — they want HSM-backed CMKs for production, but for the POC they said they'd accept a managed CloudHSM instance if we can show attestation and rotation controls. Pen-test note: they require an external pentest sign-off before final cutover. Pen-test queue is ~2–3w. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ryan_engineering: Technical constraints / options: 
- Option A: Dedicated Redwood Dedicated + BYOK (HSM-backed CMK). Pros: low latency, meets attestation. Cons: needs reserved capacity + HSM throughput charge.
- Option B: Hosted w/ customer CloudHSM proxy + key reference (short-term POC). Pros: faster onboarding. Cons: slightly higher p99 due to proxy hops.

ryan_engineering: For latency testing, we usually run a simple key-wrap ping: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://key-proxy.acme.example/wrap \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD-POC-TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"key_id":"cust-1234","payload":"hello"}'
```
Expect ~12–30ms per call on Dedicated, ~40–120ms via external proxy depending on network. We should surface those numbers in the SOW.

elaine_sales: Pricing / SOW asks: what's the delta to add HSM-backed CMK to their POC quote (2-week POC, up to 100 qps peak)? Also need wording for "pen-test hold" in SOW (i.e., SLA/activation contingent on external pentest completion).

quotebot: Quick estimate: HSM surcharge for 2-week POC (CloudHSM on-demand profile) ~ $1,200–$1,800 + per-token usage. Dedicated reserved estimate (monthly prorated) ~ $6k–$10k depending on instance. Add 1x engineering support day for cutover runbook. See template: https://redwood.example/sow-templates/byo-key-poc

omar_solutions: Action items: 
1) Ryan to draft cutover runbook + latency table and sample commands (by EOD Fri).
2) Maria to prepare attestation/controls checklist and pen-test gating language for SOW (by Tue).
3) Elaine to update quote with option A/B and send to customer for signoff.
4) Ops to request pen-test window; note queue 2–3w.

maria_security: Pen-test gating language suggestion (draft): "Customer acceptance and final production cutover are contingent upon customer-conducted external penetration test with findings remediated or mutually accepted exceptions documented in the SOW. Redwood will support evidence collection and provide attestation artifacts on request."

ryan_engineering: Network checklist for customer (copy to include in runbook): 
- TLS termination allowed to key proxy IPs (list will be provided)
- Outbound connectivity from Redwood to CloudHSM endpoints on TCP 443
- Maintain <100ms RTT to region for acceptable p99s

ryan_engineering: I'll open a PR to the runbooks repo and attach sample `curl` results and a small script to reproduce load. ETA Mon 5/6.

deploybot: Scheduled runbook stub created: https://redwood.example/runbooks/byo-cutover/1765001234 (private). Attachments: initial checklist + SOW draft.

elaine_sales: OK — I'll include the two pricing options in the proposal and highlight the pen-test dependency. Can someone from eng be on the call Thurs 3pm PST to walk through cutover steps? cc @ryan_engineering @omar_solutions

omar_solutions: Oncall schedule looks clear, I can join.

ryan_engineering: I can make Thurs 3pm PST. Will bring latency bench + sample scripts.

maria_security: I'll join the compliance portion and run through the questionnaire items.

elaine_sales: Great. Closing loop for now — I'll send updated quote + invite. If pen-test timing slips we flag a production cutover SLA exception in SOW. :white_check_mark:
